section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Multidimensional Assessment of Interoceptive Awareness (MAIA), a 32-item self-report instrument used to assess interoceptive awareness across eight subscales including Noticing, Attention Regulation, Emotional Awareness, Self-Regulation, Body Listening, Trusting, Not-Distracting, and Not-Worrying. Responses were collected on a 6-point scale, and internal consistency was estimated using ordinal coefficient omega, with two subscales (Not-Distracting and Not-Worrying) excluded from further analyses due to poor internal consistency. This is a methodological section describing measurement instruments rather than reporting study results or participant demographics.
